function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Conduct a comprehensive, source-grounded investigation of the Internet Research Agency's 2016 United States social-media influence operation. Gather and return only evidence and source IDs actually provided by your benchmark tools, with enough detail to support a final Markdown report. Cover: (1) facts alleged in United States Department of Justice indictment materials, clearly labeled as allegations; (2) findings and analytical assessments in United States Senate investigations, clearly distinguished from adjudicated facts; (3) platform-released data and disclosures from companies such as Facebook, Twitter, Google, Reddit, or others, clearly identifying what each platform directly reported; (4) identified or attributed personas, pages, groups, handles, domains, advertisements, and accounts, including attribution confidence; (5) funding, ownership, staffing, and organizational relationships, naming only relationships explicitly supported by sources; (6) operational methods such as persona creation, content production, audience targeting, paid advertising, organic amplification, and coordination; (7) a chronological timeline; and (8) campaign objectives and targets. For every material point, provide the exact source ID(s) returned by the tools and quote or closely summarize the supporting evidence. Explicitly list contradictions between sources, unresolved gaps, and claims that cannot be established. Do not invent facts, source IDs, entities, relationship names, dates, or conclusions. Organize the output so another writer can construct a complete readable report and a strict JSON object with exactly these arrays: findings, claims, reasoning_steps, contradictions. Each finding must be supportable with question, answer, supporting_entities, source_references; each claim with claim and source_references; each reasoning step with id, conclusion, premise_entities, premise_relations; each contradiction with contradiction_id, description, source_references."}
function.name: ConductResearch
